gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.
The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.

gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: We've received your ___ (REQUEST) for a refund.

gaps.explanation: 'Highly suspicious' — the adjective for something that looks wrong.
